# Verceltics

> Verceltics is an independent, open-source native app for checking the infrastructure behind your websites: hosting platforms, domain registrars and site services, with 27 direct integrations. Available on iPhone and iPad (App Store) and in beta on Android (Google Play closed testing).

## What it does

- Hosting (10): Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, Heroku, Fly.io, Firebase Hosting, AWS Amplify. Projects, deployments, logs, DNS and releases.
- Domain registrars (8): Name.com, Namecheap, Porkbun, Spaceship, Dynadot, NameSilo, Gandi, GoDaddy. Expiry, auto renew, locks, nameservers and DNS.
- Site services (9): Google Search Console, Google Analytics, PageSpeed and CrUX, Bing Webmaster, Microsoft Clarity, Plausible, Umami, UptimeRobot, Better Stack. Search, traffic, speed and uptime.
- Sample data mode lets anyone try every screen without an account.

## Privacy model

- API tokens and OAuth tokens stay on the device (iOS Keychain on iPhone and iPad, Android Keystore on Android).
- Requests go directly from the device to each provider's official API. Verceltics runs no backend or credential proxy.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any supported provider.

## Pricing

- Connecting accounts, lists, search, refresh and account switching are free.
- Verceltics Pro: $4.99 per month, $34.99 per year (7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or $59.99 once. Local prices are shown by the App Store or Google Play.
